p: turn and encamp before: From toward the country of the Philistines.
Pihahiroth: So the Sea was before them, mountains on either side, and the enemies at their back: yet they obeyed God, and were delivered.
be honoured upon Pharaoh: By punishing his obstinate rebellion.
all the chariots of Egypt: Josephus writes that besides those chariots, there were 50,000 horsemen, and 80,000 footmen.
high hand: With great joy and boldness.
afraid: They who earlier had rejoiced in their deliverance, being now in danger, are afraid.
us alone: Such is the impatience of the flesh, that it cannot wait for God's appointed time.
hold your peace: Only put your trust in God without grudging or doubting.
criest thou unto me: Thus in temptation faith fights against the flesh, and cries with inward groanings to the Lord.
light by night to these: The cloud gave light to the Israelites, but to the Egyptians it was darkness, so that their two groups could not join together.
watch the LORD looked unto the: Which was about the last three hours of the night.
overthrew the Egyptians in the midst: So, using the water, the Lord saved his own and drowned his enemies.
servant Moses: That is, the doctrine which he taught them in the Name of the Lord.
